mentions.name: Criticaster
mentions.description: A Metacritic-like website for any product: it collects professional critic reviews for a given product category, analyzes each review to assign a score, and calculates an average critic score to surface the best-of-the-best products, aiming to be the most trustworthy source for product decisions.
mentions.problem: No Metacritic-equivalent existed for consumer products when making purchase decisions, despite being the best way to discover movies, games, and TV shows.
mentions.audience: Consumers who want trustworthy guidance on which products to buy
